summary: safeGit now returns an object with code, stdout and stderr instead of a stdout string. It also no longer throws when git fails.

findings.title: Return type change breaks both CLI callers
findings.problem: safeGit now returns a GitResult object, but currentBranch calls name.trim() and changedFiles calls out.split() on it. Neither caller was updated in this change.
findings.consequence: currentBranch catches the TypeError and always returns null, so the CLI always prints not a git repository and exits. changedFiles would throw a TypeError if it were reached.
findings.fix: Update currentBranch and changedFiles to read result.stdout and to check result.code. Or keep the old string-returning function next to the new one.

findings.title: Removed throw breaks the outside-a-repository check
findings.problem: currentBranch returns null outside a repository only because safeGit used to throw when git failed. safeGit now catches the failure and returns a non-zero code instead.
findings.consequence: Once the callers read stdout, currentBranch returns an empty string outside a repository and never returns null. main.ts then skips its not a git repository exit and continues with bad data.
findings.fix: Make currentBranch return null when result.code is not 0. Make changedFiles handle a non-zero code too.

findings.title: Changed safeGit behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: safeGit changed its return shape and its error behaviour. No test covers the success path or the failure path.
findings.consequence: Nothing caught that both callers break, and future regressions will go unnoticed the same way.
findings.fix: Add tests for a zero exit code and a non-zero exit code. Add tests for currentBranch outside a repository.
